name: io.github.zereight/gitlab-mcp
title: GitLab MCP Server
description: GitLab MCP server for projects, merge requests, issues, pipelines, wiki, releases, and more.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitLab personal access token for local stdio use. A non-empty value overrides GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE. One of this token, GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE, GITLAB_JOB_TOKEN, GITLAB_AUTH_COOKIE_PATH, or GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true must be set. Create a token with the GitLab scopes the tools need, such as api or read_api.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file that contains the personal access token. Read once at startup and trimmed. Ignored when GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN or --token is non-empty. A missing, unreadable, or empty file stops startup. Does not replace job token, OAuth, cookie, or remote authorization.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_JOB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional GitLab CI job token to use instead of a personal access token when running inside GitLab CI.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_AUTH_COOKIE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a GitLab authentication cookie file for cookie-based authentication.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_USE_OAUTH
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to start with GitLab OAuth instead of a personal access token, job token, or cookie file.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: GitLab OAuth application ID. When GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true, set this or GITLAB_OAUTH_TOKEN_SCRIPT.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_TOKEN_SCRIPT
environmentVariables.description: Command that prints an OAuth access token. When GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true, set this or GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: GitLab API base URL. Use https://gitlab.com/api/v4 for GitLab.com or your self-managed GitLab API URL.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_ALLOWED_PROJECT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated list of GitLab project IDs that this server is allowed to access.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_PERMISSION_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Tool exposure. Allowed values are readonly, modify, and full. Unset uses full. readonly keeps read-only tools. modify blocks delete and teardown tools.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated list of toolsets to enable, such as projects, issues, merge_requests, pipelines, releases, users, groups, wiki, or search.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated list of individual tool names to add on top of enabled toolsets.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_DENIED_TOOLS_REGEX
environmentVariables.description: Optional regular expression used to hide matching tools from the server.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOOL_POLICY_APPROVE
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated list of tool names that require explicit approval before execution.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOOL_POLICY_HIDDEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated list of tool names to hide from tools/list.

environmentVariables.name: NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 only when you intentionally need to connect to a GitLab instance with invalid or self-signed TLS certificates.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_CA_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a custom CA certificate file for self-managed GitLab instances.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MASKING_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to mask text tool results and returned errors using built-in or configured rules.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MASKING_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a response-masking JSON configuration file.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MASKING_POLICY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional protected server-owned JSON file containing managed masking policies.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MASKING_WORKSPACE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory used to resolve response-masking configuration paths.
